list.name: engine_type
list.label: Engine
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "telemetry", tag: "engine_type", predicate: (r) => r.vessel == "${vessel}", start: -30d)

list.name: engine_model
list.label: Engine model
list.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "engine" and r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.engine_model)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.engine_model}))

base = from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -12s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "contacts")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> last()
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "vessel", "_time"])
nums = base |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "range_m" or r._field == "bearing" or r._field == "rel_bearing" or r._field == "spd_kn" or r._field == "hdg" or r._field == "rel_speed_kn" or r._field == "cpa_m" or r._field == "tcpa_s" or r._field == "risk")
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["contact", "source"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
strs = base |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "encounter" or r._field == "type")
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["contact", "source"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
join(tables: {n: nums, s: strs}, on: ["contact", "source"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.range_m)
  |> sort(columns: ["cpa_m"])
  |> sort(columns: ["risk"], desc: true)
